resources.string: June connects directly to Google Drive without passing through intermediary servers.
Sync journals privately to a dedicated app folder on your Google Drive.
No external databases, tracking, or analytics. Your thoughts stay strictly private.
Used only on-device to show your sign-in status. Never saved or shared.
Restricted to June\'s app folder. The app cannot read or access other Drive files.
